known_facts_book1: Dorothy's uncle, weak and nervous from overwork on his Kansas farm, sailing to Australia to rest and visit cousins.
Takes Dorothy along for company; she goes on deck in the storm looking for him and is blown overboard.
Had actually gone to lie down in his berth, so Dorothy never finds him before the coop carries her off.
Is seen in Ozma's magic picture in a room in Sydney, white-haired, thin and lonely, missing Dorothy.
Is reunited with Dorothy at the book's very end when the magic belt wishes her to Australia; he says 'I'm better already, my darling.'
Present only at the ship's departure and the Australian reunion; absent through the whole Ev and Oz adventure.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His niece, whom he sails with and is reunited with in Australia.
known_relations_book1.Aunt Em: His wife, left at home in Kansas to mind the farm.

known_facts_book1: Dorothy's aunt, left at home on the Kansas farm to watch the hired men while Uncle Henry travels.
Cautioned Dorothy to take good care of her uncle, which is why Dorothy goes on deck in the storm.
Never appears on the page in person; she is seen only in Ozma's magic picture, washing dishes by the kitchen window, well and contented.
Never speaks and never meets Dorothy during this book.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her niece, whom she stays behind from and sees only through the magic picture.

known_facts_book1: Dorothy's pet dog, left behind in Kansas.
Appears only in Ozma's magic picture, lying fast asleep in the sun on the side porch of the Kansas farm.
Never travels with Dorothy, never reaches Ev or Oz, never present in the adventure.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His mistress, who sees him asleep in the magic picture but is far away from him.

known_facts_book1: The cruel former King of Ev who beat his servants until they died and bought Tiktok from Smith & Tinker.
In a fit of anger sold his wife and ten children to the Nome King in exchange for a long life.
Regretting the deed, he locked Tiktok in the rock, threw the key into the ocean, then jumped in after it and drowned.
Is dead before the story begins; he never appears, never speaks, and meets none of the characters.
Uncle of Princess Langwidere and father of the ten royal children.

known_relations_book1.Nome King: The monarch he sold his family to for a long life.
known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: His wife, whom he sold into slavery.
known_relations_book1.Tiktok: The clockwork man he owned, beat, and locked in the rock.
